title: Paul Gordan and Clebsch-Gordan: Source-Witnessed LaTeX and Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Paul Gordan / Clebsch-Gordan record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record contains source-witnessed German/Latin transcription and English translation working packets split out from the older mixed additional-author shelf.

Status at a glance. These are package-audited working drafts, not final critical editions. OCR is used only as a non-authoritative prose/block comparator; source renders and included scan witnesses remain the authority for formulas and mathematical readings.

Latest update. Adds Gordan_Abel25_p322_331_DE_EN_20260612.zip, covering Clebsch-Gordan Theorie der Abelschen Functionen source pp.322-331 / printed pp.300-309. The package completes all of §85, all of §86, and the opening of §87 through formula (5) and the first normalization paragraph for third-kind integrals. It includes current German/English TeX/PDF, cumulative Abelsche German/English TeX/PDF through source p331, source scan witnesses, PNG page witnesses, audit ledgers, render checks, OCR scaffold copies marked noncanonical, prior author cumulative branches, build logs, checksums, and a ZIP test. The audit reports no unresolved scan-quality blocker for pp.322-331 and records checked determinant conditions, minor relations, row/column reduction operations, and period-transformation formulas.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Adds Gordan_Abel25_p322_331_DE_EN_20260612.zip, extending the Abelsche German/English cumulative stream through source p331 / printed p309. The tranche covers source pp322-331, completing sections 85 and 86 and opening section 87 through formula (5) and the first normalization paragraph for third-kind integrals. Package includes current and cumulative TeX/PDF, source witnesses, PNG page witnesses, audit ledgers, render checks, noncanonical OCR scaffold copies, prior cumulative branches, build logs, checksums, and zip test. Package-audited working draft only; not a certified critical edition.
